description:
List your webhook endpoints

Returns every outbound webhook endpoint registered by the account, newest first and unpaged. The signing secret is not part of this response and cannot be read back at any point: it is shown once, when the endpoint is created. Use `failedDeliveries`, `lastDeliveryAt` and `lastDeliveryStatus` to spot an endpoint that has started rejecting deliveries before it is switched off automatically.
name: list_webhooks
title: List your webhook endpoints
